full_name: Prasannan Parthasarathi | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 History Beatrice Shepherd Blane Fellow Boston College
bio: Prasannan Parthasarathi is a professor of history at Boston College. He is particularly interested in environmental change, agriculture, and labor in 19th-century South India.
